data.long_meaning: Derived from the Spanish name 'Ramón', which originated from the Latin name 'Ramnus'. The name Ramon is believed to mean 'ray of light' or 'sunshine'. In Christian tradition, Ramon is associated with the biblical figure of Ramon, who was a shepherd mentioned in the Old Testament. The name Ramon carries the meaning “Ray of light, sunshine” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ramon usually hope their child will grow to embody ray of light, sunshine and live with faith, good character and purpose.
